text:
maria: Heads up — we just saw a 5xx/504 spike after ramping the kernel-selector v3 canary to 10%. Customer reports timeouts and billing alerts firing. :rotating_light:

alex: seeing same in dashboards. p50 stable but p95 jumps and error-rate up ~6x.

jordan: any deploys or flag flips around 09:12 UTC? I see a config push from release-umbrella.

maria: release pipeline shows 'kernel-selector:v3' staged at 09:08 -> 10% traffic. config key `selector_scope` was set to `global` in the canary bundle. I think that was supposed to be `service`.

devops: confirmed — selector_scope=global was merged into canary by mistake. That routes inference traffic through the new kernel for shared infra paths. Rolling back now.

support-ops: we already have 3 customer escalations for 504s, one billing-critical. Customers: AcmeAnalytics, BrightChat. Putting on priority dispatch.

alex: logs from edge show repeated upstream timeouts: 
```
[2026-06-15T09:13:22Z] gateway: upstream request timeout (t=10s) kernel-selector=v3 route=/v1/generate tenant=acme
[2026-06-15T09:13:22Z] 504 POST /v1/generate  t=10.002s
```

jordan: looks like v3 has higher cold-start or incompatible kernel param for some model shapes — KV cache path mismatch?

maria: reproducer: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"open-llm-7b","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --max-time 12
-> consistently 504 when routed to v3 nodes. Works when pinned to v2.

devops: rollback command issued: `orchctl rollout cancel kernel-selector:v3 && orchctl set kernel-selector stable=v2 --force`
sre-bot: Rollback started (runbook: /runbooks/deploy-rollback.md). Notifying on-call.

elaine: sending proactive messages to affected customers and pausing billing alerts until we validate. Patch note: estimated 20 min for traffic to drain.

support-ops: forwarding customer repro steps + logs to eng. Ask customers to retry in 10m.

alex: after rollback traffic and error-rate are trending down. p95 latency still recovering but 504s dropping.

jordan: follow-up action items: 1) add stricter review gate for selector_scope changes, 2) add an automated test that spins up v3 with model matrix for critical tenants, 3) ensure canary scope defaults to `service` not `global`.

maria: filing a postmortem and creating a flag to prevent global-scoped kernel flips.

devops: rolling forward once burn-in tests pass. Will coordinate with support for customer update.

elaine: customer update sent: "we identified an internal rollout that briefly affected request routing; services are restored, and billing anomalies are paused. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

support-ops: marking incident severity P2 -> P3 after rollback and customer confirmations.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll start the incident doc and tag owners for remediation tasks.
